title: Sharp few-copy decoding with coherent streamed fiber ranks

claims.statement: For every N >= 2 and every s modulo N, the threshold-controlled streamed fiber-rank decoder in proof.md uses n=ceil(log2 N) and acquires exactly k in {n,n+1}, determined by its public rational moment and Poisson guard. It recovers all of s with unconditional probability greater than 2/3 from independent ideal copies. The same configuration jointly has branchwise total charged work O(2^((107/250)n)), with exact growth index 1.

It recovers all of s with unconditional probability greater than 2/3 from independent ideal copies. The same configuration jointly has peak allocated classical space O(2^((2853/10000)n)) bits on every branch, with exact growth index 1.

For every N >= 2 and every s modulo N, the threshold-controlled streamed fiber-rank decoder in proof.md uses n=ceil(log2 N) and acquires exactly k in {n,n+1}, determined by its public rational moment and Poisson guard. It recovers all of s with unconditional probability greater than 2/3 from independent ideal copies. The same configuration jointly has peak allocated quantum space O(n) qubits on every branch, with growth index exactly 0.

For every N >= 2 and every s modulo N, the threshold-controlled streamed fiber-rank decoder in proof.md uses n=ceil(log2 N) and acquires exactly k in {n,n+1}, determined by its public rational moment and Poisson guard. It recovers all of s with unconditional probability greater than 2/3 from independent ideal copies. The same configuration jointly has acquisition count exactly the selected k on every branch, which is O(n) and has growth index exactly 0. Along any sequence with n tending to infinity and 2^n/N converging to a value other than the unique threshold specified in proof.md, this count is eventually the minimum possible count for worst-secret success at least 2/3.

It recovers all of s with unconditional probability greater than 2/3 from independent ideal copies. The same configuration jointly has guaranteed malformed fraction epsilon(n)=0 under the independent ideal-copy model.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
